line.comment: * Task -1. Latest ejected pilot can be retrieved with the global var 'mayhem_latestPilotEjected'.
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: Check bailCopyRunning locks. Do not duplicate a clone operation if either is TRUE. Note: duplication occurs most likely during Hacking.Hack.
* mayhem_beingDestroyed is checked externally (Mayhem.Task.BailMaybe, Mayhem.Hacking.Hack, and ZH.Task.PirateWarlord) before attempting to get here.
* Add-Ons 1.4.7: If a bailed ship was a boardable ship (see Mayhem.GetBailChance), then we need to pass a flag to Mayhem.CopyShip.
* The bailed boardable ships are: M6, TM, M1, M2, M7.
* Add-Ons 1.4.10: Need to save the pandora tunings.
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: Safety. If the new ship doesn't exist (should never happen) and this global script is still running, return null.
* Will freeze to death if $attacker is invalid.
* Mordan7 - bailed capital ships can't be captured by player tugs either.
* fix attempt for bail cmd removing equipment sometimes. Check successful copy before equipment.
* Add-Ons 1.4.10: Handle pandora tuning retention. (Moved to new script in 1.4.22). Check successful copy before restoring tunings.
